en.hubeali: H 14749 – From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Abu Yahya Al-Wasity, from Ajlaan Abu Salih who said:

A man came up to Abu Abdullahasws, so he said to himasws, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws. This here (the sky) is the dome of Adamas?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes. By Allahazwj, there are numerous domes. Indeed! Behind this West of yours are thirty-nine (other) in the West, white lands filled with creatures illuminated by its light. They have never disobeyed Allahazwj even for the blink of an eye. These creatures are not aware of the creation of Adamas, but they are distancing themselves (Tabarra) from so and so and so and so (Abu Bakr and Umar)’.
en.sarwar: 301. From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Abu Yahya Al-Wasity, from Ajlaan Abu Salih who said:

A man came up to Abu Abdullah (a.s.), so he said to him (a.s.), ‘May I be sacrificed for you (a.s.). This here (the sky) is the dome of Adam (as)?’ He (a.s.) said: ‘Yes. By Allah (azwj), there are numerous domes. Indeed! Behind this West of yours are thirty-nine (other) in the West, white lands filled with creatures illuminated by its light. They have never disobeyed Allah (azwj) even for the blink of an eye. These creatures are not aware of the creation of Adam (as), but they are distancing themselves (Tabarra) from so and so and so and so (Abu Bakr and Umar)’.
